lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of discrete, high-luminance circular spots arranged in a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical regions of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to create a grid of high-luminance anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal feature is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral) along a horizontal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the dorsal fin displays a high density of small, high-luminance spots relative to the larger spots on the main flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent artificial satellite or acoustic tag is attached to the mid-flank, consisting of a dark tethering line and a white, tapered cylindrical housing.
